description: Finds the pages on woebike.de that answer a question about E-Bikes: comparison pages with current prices (by feature or price range), buying guides and brand pages – each with title, summary and link. USE WHEN the user wants advice rather than one price: "which E-Bike should I buy", "what to look for", "is X worth it", "models by <brand>", or a how-to/problem topic. PARAMETERS: "query" = topic or question (optional; without it you get the main entry pages). EXAMPLES: {"query":"E-Mountainbikes"} · {"query":"Trekking-E-Bikes","language":"en"}. RETURNS: browse.comparisons[], browse.guides[], browse.brands[], browse.featured[] (title, url, description) and siteSearchUrl (price list for the query). Cite the pages and give the links UNCHANGED. Set "language" to the user's language.

language.description: Language of the linked pages (ISO 639-1, e.g. "de", "en", "tr", "ar", "fr"). Set it to the user's language. Default: Accept-Language header, otherwise "de"; unsupported languages fall back to "en".

name: find_pages
title: Find buying guides and comparison pages on woebike.de
